mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_key, payload_json, status) VALUES ( 'GENERATION_JOB', #{aggregateId}, 'GENERATION_JOB_QUEUED', #{eventKey}, jsonb_build_object( 'jobId', #{aggregateId}, 'jobType', #{jobType}, 'projectId', CAST(#{projectId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'storyVersionId', CAST(#{storyVersionId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'chapterId', CAST(#{chapterId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'chapterRowVersion', CAST(#{chapterRowVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS BIGINT), 'sourceHash', #{sourceHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'contentVariantId', CAST(#{contentVariantId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'sourceVariantId', CAST(#{sourceVariantId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'targetLanguage', #{targetLanguage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'mediaPlanId', CAST(#{mediaPlanId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AS UUID), 'mediaPlanRevision', CAST(#{mediaPlanRevision,jdbcType=INTEGER} AS INTEGER), 'productionMode', CAST(#{productionMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT) ), 'PENDING' ) ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND event_type IN ('GENERATION_JOB_QUEUED', 'MEDIA_VALIDATION_REQUESTED') AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT 50 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE outbox_events event SET available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{reservationMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') FROM candidates WHERE event.id = candidates.id RETURNING event.id
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
